evals.prompt: Our existing docs tree has Markdown files without OKF headers. Add deterministic headers without changing any file that already has frontmatter.
evals.expected_output: The helper reports missing concept-document headers, writes derived OKF frontmatter only to those files, preserves existing frontmatter byte-for-byte, and prints a stable JSON summary.
assertions: Running headers --check exits nonzero and reports each missing concept-document path
Running headers --write derives type from the first bundle path segment
Title comes from the first level-one heading and description from the first prose line
Timestamp uses the last git commit date when available and the configured default date otherwise
Existing valid frontmatter and document bodies remain unchanged
A second headers --write run reports an empty written list

evals.prompt: Our docs index catalog is stale after adding and renaming documents. Regenerate only the generated catalog regions and verify there is no remaining drift.
evals.expected_output: The helper detects drift without writing in check mode, regenerates grouped and sorted entries in write mode, preserves prose outside markers, and leaves hand-maintained indexes untouched.
assertions: index --check exits nonzero and lists every drifted index path without modifying the tree
index --write groups file entries under alphabetically sorted type headings
Entries within each type are sorted case-insensitively by title
The Sections heading is last and includes immediate Markdown-containing subdirectories
Text outside generated markers is preserved byte-for-byte
Index files without generated markers are reported as unmanaged and are not changed
A final index --check exits zero with an empty drifted list

evals.prompt: Set up the standard OKF documentation system in a fresh repository, using the deterministic default date so repeated runs are identical.
evals.expected_output: The helper creates the complete docs bundle, including the root catalog, thirteen core guides, four specialized indexes, and two reference documents, without overwriting existing paths.
assertions: scaffold creates exactly the documented 20 files under docs by default
The bundle-root index declares okf_version 0.1 and contains generated-index markers
Every core guide has Guide frontmatter, a deterministic timestamp, and a PLACE HOLDER body
Specialized index files have generated markers and no frontmatter
Docs maintenance and entrypoint readme template references are created with Reference type
A second scaffold run creates no files, reports all paths as existing, and leaves the tree byte-identical

evals.prompt: Audit this docs bundle for OKF and repository documentation violations. Report everything, but do not modify any files.
evals.expected_output: The check command returns sorted JSON errors and warnings, exits nonzero only for errors, and leaves the repository byte-identical.
assertions: Missing or invalid frontmatter and empty type values are reported as errors with file paths
Generated index drift and Markdown-containing subdirectories without index.md are reported as errors
Root docs over 500 lines and non-ISO log headings are reported as errors
Broken relative links and missing recommended title or description keys are warnings
Warnings alone do not cause a nonzero exit
The summary counts errors, warnings, Markdown files, and concept documents
A before-and-after tree hash proves the command wrote no files
